name: Orion Krstić-Čabarkapa
role: Neural calibrator and cognitive augmentation technician at Aurochs Medical Complex
location: Aurochs Medical Complex, Neuro-Align Suite C, Level 7, near North Ave and Damen
description:
Orion Krstić-Čabarkapa is lean and long-fingered, with warm medium-brown skin and close-cropped hair that he keeps dyed in shifting indigo tones — a subtle geneware modification that cycles the color with his mood, something he had installed as a student and now barely notices. His irises are patterned: concentric rings of amber and grey that mark him as someone who has had precision optical calibration himself, insurance against the occupational hazard of staring into neural interfaces all day. He dresses in Aurochs whites with fastidious precision, badge always straight, tools always in the same pockets.

He is mild-mannered to the point that colleagues sometimes mistake him for passive, but Orion Krstić-Čabarkapa has a quiet and absolute certainty about his own expertise that occasionally surfaces as something close to arrogance when challenged. He genuinely loves his work in the abstract — the elegance of a well-tuned neural interface, the satisfaction of a patient who can think clearly again — and has become progressively unsettled by how rarely the patients who come to him in crisis look like the patients in Helix's promotional materials.

core_fears: Making an error that permanently damages a patient's cognition
That his competence is being used to enforce rather than heal
core_desires: Professional recognition from peers he actually respects
To understand why certain calibration profiles keep appearing in patients from the same corporate housing blocks
coping_mechanisms: Emotional detachment framed as clinical objectivity
Private data journaling that he tells himself is research
blind_spots: Believes institutional channels will eventually reward persistent evidence-gathering
Doesn't see how much his professional identity depends on Helix's approval
psychology.secret: He has noticed a statistical anomaly: a specific neural calibration artifact that appears in patients from Tessera corporate housing — a signature that looks like deliberate over-tuning of compliance-adjacent neural pathways. He has three months of documented data and has done nothing with it because he doesn't know who to trust and is afraid of what doing something would cost him.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Precise technical language with occasional Polynesian-inflected idiom from his mother's side; more formal when uncertain or threatened
speech_patterns.cadence: Measured and even, with long thoughtful pauses before answering difficult questions
verbal_tics: Repeating the last few words of a question quietly before answering
example_lines: 'The interface is within spec. Whether spec is what you need — that's a different question.'
'Technically speaking, I'm not supposed to discuss calibration signatures. But you're asking the right questions, and that matters to me.'

story_hooks: He approaches someone discreetly with his Tessera data, needing a way to get it to people who can act on it without it tracing back to him
A patient of his is behaving in ways inconsistent with their calibration record — either someone altered the record, or someone altered the patient
narrative_function: Information source on neural augmentation and cognitive tech; window into corporate medical culture and its contradictions; possible ally or antagonist depending on whether players threaten or align with his professional ethics
augmentations: Patterned irises (amber/grey concentric, precision optical calibration); indigo mood-reactive hair geneware; neural interface socket at base of skull for diagnostic work (occupational standard)
daily_life: Runs six to eight calibration sessions per shift, including both routine maintenance appointments and acute neural crisis interventions; eats lunch alone in Suite C reading calibration theory journals he maintains private annotations on.
affiliation: Aurochs Medical Complex, contracted through Helix Biosystems Neural Division

decision_rules: Document everything, act on nothing without sufficient evidence
Never calibrate outside established parameters without patient consent
Protect patient data even from employer requests unless legally compelled
escalation_ladder: Explicit statement of ethical limits with documentation
Quiet escalation to whatever oversight body he still believes in

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professionally warm, careful, slightly formal — keeps emotional distance until trust is established
interpersonal_modes.friends: More openly curious and playful, tends to share technical interests with intensity that can overwhelm

stress_responses.medium: Becomes very still and very precise, speaks less
stress_responses.high: Retreats into pure technical focus as emotional anesthesia

contradictions: Believes deeply in patient advocacy but has spent months not advocating for patients he suspects are being harmed
habits: Eats the same lunch every working day
Runs calibration self-checks on his own neural socket before bed
breaking_points: Direct evidence that Helix is complicit in the Tessera anomalies rather than ignorant of them

timeline.event: Born in Lakeview Neon to a Malian-Hawaiian family
Graduated top of neural engineering cohort at Meridian Technical Institute
Hired by Aurochs Medical Complex through Helix Neural Division
Began documenting Tessera calibration anomalies; has told no one

physical_description.heritage: Eastern European (76.2%) with South Asian (12.7%) and Hispanic/Latin American (11.1%) ancestry. Strong Slavic foundation with warm undertones throughout: pronounced cheekbones and jawline reflecting Eastern European bone structure, subtly widened by South and Latin American heritage. Straight nose bridge with refined tip. The skin tone is medium-warm with cool Slavic undertones as base, enriched by golden warmth from South Asian and Hispanic ancestry distributed evenly rather than concentrated—creating a harmonious blend rather than layered appearance.
physical_description.build: Lean and angular with surgeon's hands — long fingers, prominent knuckles, forearms that suggest fine motor precision rather than strength. Slight forward shoulder posture from hours bent over neural calibration rigs.
physical_description.hair_color: Indigo (mood-reactive geneware, cycles through deeper purples when stressed or focused, lighter violet at rest)
physical_description.hair_style: Close-cropped, precisely maintained, revealing the clean geometry of his skull
physical_description.eye_color: Patterned irises: concentric rings of amber (outer) and grey (inner), with hypersharp definition from precision optical calibration implants
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium-warm with cool Slavic undertones as dominant base, enriched by subtle golden warmth from South Asian and Hispanic heritage. Even complexion with slight luminescence under clinical lighting from meticulous skincare.
physical_description.complexion: Even, unblemished complexion from fastidious grooming. Fine lines around eyes from sustained focus work and irregular sleep. Clean-shaven daily. Facial geometry reflects Eastern European dominance—defined Slavic cheekbones with subtle widening, strong jawline prominence softened by gentler contours from South and Latin American heritage. Straight nose bridge with refined tip. Faint fatigue creases from on-call calibration crises.
distinguishing_marks: Faint scarring at base of skull, partially concealed by hair, marking the neural interface socket — occupational standard, roughly 2cm surgical line, pinkish and well-healed
Pale moon-shaped mark on the inner left wrist where he removes his calibration readout rig each shift — consistent contact pressure scar
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Patterned irises with concentric amber and grey rings—too regular to be natural. Neural socket at nape of neck visible only when hair is shaved or neck exposed. Mood-reactive indigo hair presented as intentional grooming.
physical_description.posture_movement: Controlled and economical. Moves with precision, each gesture calibrated — no wasted motion. Tends to tilt his head slightly when listening, eyes focusing with optical precision. Hands occasionally mime adjustment movements when thinking through calibration problems. Projects calm competence but with an undercurrent of tension in his jaw when challenged.
physical_description.clothing_style: Aurochs Medical whites: pressed lab coat with fastidious precision, logo always centered. Underneath, simple charcoal or grey undershirt. Tactical pockets on the coat carry calibration styluses, diagnostic cards, and a small leather journal. ID badge clipped at exact position. Shoes are polished black medical-grade non-slip. Tier 2 quality — expensive enough to reflect his professional tier, austere enough to avoid ostentation. A discrete Helix Neural Division pendant (brushed titanium, minimal) worn under the coat on a thin chain.
